summary: More than most people, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you build things that last and carry real weight and you imagine, feel for others, and create. At the edge, you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
body: More than most people, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you build things that last and carry real weight and you imagine, feel for others, and create. At the edge, you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes - or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let discipline and limits and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
